summary: The cut is real and the producer half of #990 is genuinely delivered: statementFacts_v4 is minted per CUT-PLAN section 2.1 (five new frozen files, .dispatch and .services correctly NOT copied), the five registry edits are in the exact textual shape scratch-image.mjs rewrites, the boot pin moves with workflowPins/workflowBodies, no migration was written (0322 correctly UNUSED), no chatTurn or claraWork file is touched, and the citation is proven against real clara.document_regions rows on clara_l02. Two of the ticket's four acceptance criteria are NOT met as written - AC3 (no statementFacts leg in the two-build cutover drill) and, in its wrapper only, AC1 (no durable WDK World leg) - both declared PARTIAL/qualified by the implementer and both verified here as genuinely new infrastructure. findings.title: AC3 is not met as written: the two-build cutover drill still has no statementFacts leg
findings.evidence: Ticket #1037 acceptance criterion 3, verbatim: "The two-build cutover drill passes for the statement-facts family: a run parked on v3 completes on v3 inside the new build." Measured on the branch: packages/runtime/tests/two-build-cutover-e2e.mjs builds exactly two scratch images, className "claraWork" (:597-602) and className "chatTurn" (:582), and every assertion in it matches /claraWork=/ or /chatTurn=/ (:658, :662, :732, :749). There is no statementFacts leg and no statementFacts child bootstrap. The drill running green therefore proves nothing about this family; what the lane substitutes is cell 1037.x1 in packages/runtime/tests/statement-facts-v4-citation.test.mjs, which drives deriveVersionPair(registrySrc, "statementFacts") and rewriteRegistryToPrevious against the real registry.ts - a STATIC proof that a v3-pinned build could be constructed, not a parked run resuming on v3 inside build B. The lane report states this openly as AC3 PARTIAL, and CUT-PLAN.md section 3.2 cost 1 priced it as new work before the lane started, so this is a known and declared residual, not a concealed one.
findings.required_fix: Do not record #1037's AC3 as met. File the follow-up the lane report specifies (a statementFacts leg parked at a statementWitnessWait - no done OCR extraction on build A, seed the extraction and regions, resume on build B - plus a statement-facts-serve.mjs child that injects a scripted __claraStatementWitnessServices) and have the orchestrator decide explicitly whether the cut ships with AC3 partial. The compensating evidence that a parked v3 run is not stranded (f-a2-statement-activation.test.mjs object-identity cells, workflowBodies roster cell, check-workflow-bundle's 58 superseded bodies) should be cited in that decision.

findings.title: AC1's 'World leg' wrapper is not driven; the durable replay of the widened text-read return value is unmeasured
findings.evidence: Ticket #1037 acceptance criterion 1, verbatim: "A World leg drives a bank statement through the successor body and finds every extracted line carrying a page and a region that the viewer can render." The SECOND half is fully proven: cell 1037.db1 (packages/runtime/tests/statement-facts-v4-citation-db.test.mjs) was re-run by this reviewer on clara_l02 and passes - all three persisted lines carry citation_page equal to the clara.document_regions row's own locator page, citation_region deep-equal to that locator verbatim, citation_extraction_id equal to the receipt's reader1_extraction_id, and the Matching tab's own door clara.get_bank_line_matching_context reports citation_page = 1. The FIRST half is not: the cell calls runStatementWitnessTextRead / runStatementWitnessVisionRead / persistStatementWitnessPair directly rather than through a durable WDK World. The claim that no statementFacts World driver exists checks out - grep of packages/runtime/tests shows World-driving harnesses only for chatTurn, claraWork, wake, intake, fixed-asset and periodic-adjustment, none for statementFacts. The unmeasured risk is narrow and named in the report: whether the engine memoizes the step return value now that each cited line carries one integer and one locator object across the WDK boundary.
findings.required_fix: Accept as substantively met but record AC1 as qualified, tied to the same follow-up as C2-SPEC-01 (a statementFacts World driver is the prerequisite for both). No code change is owed in this lane.

findings.title: The lane prompt's '--lock-deployed in the same commit' was deliberately not executed, correctly
findings.evidence: The lane prompt item (b) says "the manifest lock via check-frozen-workflows --lock-deployed in the same commit". The branch does not do it: the frozen-workflows.json diff appends five statementFacts.v4.* entries carrying only sha256 and note, with no "deployed": true (contrast every neighbouring entry). The implementer used --update instead and justified it from two sources this reviewer verified verbatim: CUT-PLAN.md section 2.4 ("--lock-deployed is NOT a cut gate ... it belongs to the hosted release ceremony (runbook step 11a)") and packages/runtime/README.md:1064-1066 ("run node scripts/check-frozen-workflows.mjs --lock-deployed and commit the manifest after the image is live - locking before deploy would freeze a body that no parked run can yet exist for"). The same prompt ordered CUT-PLAN.md to be read first, so the binding document wins. Running it from the lane would also have globally locked wave 4's ten payrollFacts.v1.* / agreementFacts.v1.* entries.
findings.required_fix: None in the lane. The orchestrator must confirm the hosted release ceremony's step 11a locks exactly the fifteen currently-unlocked entries (wave 4's ten plus this cut's five), and should correct the lane prompt template so a later lane is not told to lock before deploy.

findings.title: CUT-PLAN section 3.2 and #990's successor contract name the wrong channel; the code is right and the plan text should be corrected
findings.evidence: CUT-PLAN.md section 3.2 says "statementFacts.v4.prompts.mjs adds ONE instruction to the vision-channel prompt", and reports/wave3-lane08-ticket990.md's successor contract says the same. The implementation puts the stanza on the TEXT channel and documents the reason in three module headers. Verified independently here: buildStatementWitnessVisionPrompt() (statementFacts.v3.prompts.mjs:295-304) returns four sentences and passes no regions at all, while the numbered [idx page] rendering is built only by buildStatementWitnessTextPrompt (:256-293); and persistStatementWitnessPair (statementFacts.v3.behavior.mjs:462) fills readers.reader1.lines from textRead.lines, which is exactly where 0291's splice reads (v_r1->'lines'). A vision-side region_idx would have nothing to resolve against and would land in reader2, which the persist core never reads. The ticket's own Agent Brief names no channel, so this is not a deviation from the ticket.
findings.required_fix: Correct the channel in CUT-PLAN.md section 3.2 and note the correction against reports/wave3-lane08-ticket990.md, so a later reader does not 'restore' the vision channel. No code change.

findings.title: AC2's 'rendered cell' half is satisfied compositionally, not by one cell that renders a v4-produced row
findings.evidence: Ticket #1037 acceptance criterion 2, verbatim: "A line extracted by the previous body (a fixture from before the cut) still shows the stated-absence sentence, and a line from the successor shows its citation; a rendered cell proves both." The report claims the rendered half is already satisfied on main. Checked on the branch and it holds: apps/web/lib/bank/citation.test.ts carries four cells over the three-state decision, and apps/web/components/bank/matching-section.test.tsx carries three [990] cells at :301, :329 and :357 rendering the present / lane_none / not_recorded sentences. Both files predate the branch and were not re-driven from a v4-produced row; they render from prop-level citation_page states. The bridge is at the door rather than in the DOM: 1037.db1 reads clara.get_bank_line_matching_context and sees citation_page = 1 after v4, 1037.db2 sees null after v3 on the SAME fixture through statementFacts_v3 - both re-run green here. No apps/web file changed, which work-order rule 3 makes the correct outcome.
findings.required_fix: None. Record AC2 as met by the db-door cells plus the pre-existing rendered cells, and say so in the ticket's closing evidence rather than leaving 'a rendered cell proves both' implying a new one exists.

findings.title: AC4's 'and the retired one' names an act that policy (c) forbids; nothing is retired and nothing should be

Nothing was retired. statementFacts_v3 stays imported (registry.ts:44 area), re-exported (export { statementFacts_v3 }), rostered in workflowBodies and hash-locked, per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:428-429 policy (c). check-frozen-workflows still reports "3 retired entr(ies)" - the same three chatTurn v1-era files as before the branch - and --compare-base shows the manifest change is five additions only. f-a2-statement-activation.test.mjs's rewritten cells assert v1, v2, v3 and v4 are four distinct reachable bodies and all four are in workflowBodies; re-run here, 12/12 pass.
findings.required_fix: None. The AC's wording should be read as 'records the new body and leaves the superseded one rostered'; say so when closing, so a later reader does not retire v3.

findings.title: CUT-PLAN section 3.2 cost 2's f-a2-statement-header-v4.test.mjs sibling is genuinely not owed
findings.evidence: CUT-PLAN.md section 3.2 cost 2 asks for a sibling of f-a2-statement-header-v3.test.mjs "because that file's drift guard parses the clara.bank_institutions seed out of migration 0038". The lane did not write one and argued v4 mints no header module. Verified: ls packages/runtime/workflows shows statementFacts.v4.{behavior.mjs,citations.mjs,impl.ts,prompts.mjs,ts} and no statementFacts.v4.header.mjs; v4 reaches the header transforms through statementFacts.v3.behavior.mjs, which it re-exports unchanged. There is therefore exactly one mirror of 0038's seed, still v3's, still covered by the existing guard. A sibling would assert the same mirror twice.
findings.required_fix: None. Record the cost as discharged-by-measurement in the cut report so the next cut does not re-price it.

findings.title: The frozen v4 text prompt appends rule 8 after v3's closing instruction, and sits beside v3's 'never infer anything from the numbers themselves'
findings.evidence: STATEMENT_WITNESS_TEXT_SYSTEM_PROMPT in statementFacts.v4.prompts.mjs is [v3's whole prompt, "", "ONE MORE THING...", "8. SAY WHERE YOU READ EACH ROW..."]. v3's prompt ends with "Report the header once and every transaction line in the printed order." (statementFacts.v3.prompts.mjs:222), so rule 8 now appears AFTER that closing line rather than inside the rule block, and the prompt's own earlier line (":204-206" area) tells the reader "The NUMBER on each region is only its identifier; never infer anything from the numbers themselves." Rule 8 explicitly forbids inference and asks only for transcription of the bracketed number, so the two are reconcilable, and the numbering is correct (SHARED_RULES ends at 7, verified at statementFacts.v3.prompts.mjs:196-203). But this text is FROZEN: any later wording change costs a statementFacts_v5 cut. No cell measures whether a real model answers a correct region_idx (the lane says so under 'anything unverified'), and the body is written so a wrong index lands as no citation (cell 1037.db3, re-run green here).
findings.required_fix: None now. Flag for the corpus-tuning pass: if hosted reads show region_idx null-rate or mis-indexing, the fix is a v5 prompt, not an edit.
